title: The Final Chapters Special (1)
overview: As the rumbling advances, the remaining members of the Scout Regiment race against the clock with their Marleyan and Azumabito allies to catch up to Eren and stop the rumbling before the rest of the world is crushed under the Wall Titans' feet.

title: The Final Chapters Special (2)
overview: Eren, as the Founding Titan, advances on Fort Salta with countless other Titans. Appearing before the refugees, who stand on the brink of despair, are Mikasa, Armin, Jean, Conny, Reiner, Pieck, and Levi, who narrowly escaped from the rumbling. The battle between former comrades and childhood friends with Eren concludes here.
